svg.aria-label: How I work, in three stages. One: understand. Two: build. Three: deliver.
svg.title: How I work, in three stages. One: understand. Two: build. Three: deliver.

g.text: Sit with the people who do the work
and the people who pay for it.
Turn a loose need into requirements,
a data model and a plan they sign off.
auditable and secure enough for a
Own the outcome, not the ticket.
